title: Power Apps: Power Apps CLI commands to find connectors and create connections for code apps
summary: The briefing understates documented development-time connector policy enforcement. Microsoft now documents that adding a data source checks connector policies before selecting or creating a connection, so the page should not describe those policies as governing app use but not what developers can create.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Connection creation from the CLI has no documented policy enforcement, so data policies govern app use rather than what developers can create.
claims.quote: The command checks your organization's Advanced Connector Policies (ACP) and Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies before selecting or creating a connection or retrieving datasets and tables.
claims.fix: Replace the broad absence in Data exposure and the 'not over what developers can create' conclusion with: 'Learn documents ACP and DLP checks in pa app add data-source before selecting or creating a connection; a blocked connector or one with all actions blocked returns exit code 2 without creating a connection or data source files. If the tenant cannot be identified or the policy service is unavailable, the CLI warns and continues without the add-time check; refresh does not repeat that check.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/developer/code-apps/reference/cli. Keep the narrower uncertainty about the standalone pa connection create command, and remove 'or does it apply only when the app launches?' from the open question.

claims.claim: The documented data policy control is not confirmed for CLI commands.
claims.quote: [`pa app add data-source`](../reference/cli#pa-app-add-data-source-remarks) checks your organization's Advanced Connector Policies (ACP) and Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies. A blocked connector can't be added.
claims.fix: Replace 'Not confirmed for the CLI commands.' in the row note and rendered table with 'Learn documents ACP and DLP checks when pa app add data-source adds a connector.' The existing cited connect-to-data page states this; the CLI reference gives the check's failure and bypass conditions.
